验证记录（值班室 2026-09-18 夜班，独立实跑，非复述 PR 描述）：

用仓库**真正的门禁命令**（SKILL.md:98 与 references/runtime-neutrality.md:65 两处一致的那条）实跑，
构造真红灯样本撞新增的判别表，确认新规则按「出现位置」分栏后**不会把真红灯误判成假阳性**——
这是合并前最需要排除的风险，已排除。

两点如实记录，供后续参考：
1. PR 描述里「实测复现」用的 grep 命令与仓库门禁命令不是同一条（前者少扫了 README.md），
   所以「8 处全部是假阳性」这个数字复核不上；实跑命中 5 处。
2. 「3 个 judge 3-0」无法复核，未作为合并依据。

合并依据是 diff 本身经得起对抗测试，与作者给出的证据无关。

fix(runtime-scan): 红灯扫描自指假阳性——讲解规则的 skill 会永判自己 P0

红灯 grep 把『引用/演示该 pattern 本身』的行也命中：darwin-skill 自己讲解
runtime 中立性规则时必然字面写出『Claude Code skill』等措辞，对它跑那条
grep 命中 8 处，按『输出非空=强制 P0』会把 darwin 自己（及任何讲 runtime
中立性的 skill）永远判成红灯、陷入自审死循环。

- references/runtime-neutrality.md 例外清单补第5类『引用/演示 pattern 本身』
  + 真红灯 vs 假阳性判别表 + 命中后须读上下文再定性

Phase 2 keep/revert: paired within-judge comparison instead of absolute-score delta (#13)

* feat: paired-comparison ratchet replacing absolute-score delta (v2.1)

Absolute-score keep/revert is unreliable: the same unchanged SKILL.md scores +/-8 across judges (LLM judge = sampling not measurement; each judge resamples its own scoring standard per call). Phase 2 keep/revert now uses paired within-judge comparison (one judge reads before+after in one call so its idiosyncratic ruler cancels) + odd-N majority vote; absolute total demoted to triage-only. Aligns the workflow with the skill's own reflex #1, which the old absolute-delta workflow contradicted.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Music: sixteen worlds to choose from, a soundprint that catches a repeated band

Ten test films in a row, and a live film the same day, all played the band of the example score
Signal (synpluck, supersaw, violins, piano, synbass, an 808 and a pop kit) at about 120 BPM in a
minor key: the composer copied the nearest example's header every time.

- references/music.md: sixteen musical worlds (pulse minimalism, UK garage, minimal techno, drum and
  bass, funk, lo-fi, trap, synthwave, cinematic, lyrical piano waltz, jazz trio, folk, chiptune,
  ambient, guofeng electronic, amapiano), each with the products it suits, tempo, band, references
  and a two-bar groove that renders. Measured on renders: the worlds spread the A-weighted low end
  from 0 to 21 % and the spectral centroid from 0.5 to 2.4 kHz; the ten films sat at 2-8 % and 1.0-2.1 kHz.
- Each direction card names its music world; the three cards are three different worlds.
- The example scores are for structure, not sound.
- om sound prints the score's soundprint (tempo, key, band) and warns when it is an example score's
  band or the band of a recent film on this machine (~/.huashu-motion/soundtracks.jsonl).
- Score drum kits lofi, gated, chip and folk reach drum voices the engine had but scores could not use.
- Tests run with their own OM_HOME so they never write to the user's history.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Depth is one of three choices, carried through the film when chosen; frame 0 is the poster

Exactly one of the three directions is a depth direction and the other two are other styles, so the
user can choose 3D and always has something else; which one is recommended follows the product and
the brief, not 3D by default. When depth is chosen the camera travels through one space for the whole
film (stations in depth, transitions through space, at most one flat beat), planned in the treatment.

om qa flags an empty frame 0 — the poster feeds, players and README GIFs show before playing — and
says when the frame fills. Calibrated on 15 films: those opening on their subject had 7-94 % off-median
pixels and 2-18 % edges in frame 0; blank, black or a lone small mark had under 2.5 % and 1.2 %.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Depth: OM.space 3D camera, Three.js studio helpers, ui-space and object-3d templates

OM.space drives a CSS 3D page world or a Three.js camera from the same poses (target, distance, yaw,
pitch, roll, fov, fit, flat); moves run on arcs and the pose is a pure function of time, so any frame
renders alone and flat: true lands exactly on the layout. runtime/three bundles three.js r186 with
the add-ons a studio needs; om-three.js gives a lit stage with a dark-parted environment, a studio
sweep, the real logo SVG extruded in its own colours, screenshots on devices or cropped into panels,
GLB/HDR loading that works from file://, depth of field that follows the camera's target, and one
render per frame after every tween has been set (a draw inside the clock tween showed last frame's
values; loads redraw when they land so frame one is never captured before its texture).

Templates ui-space (the real interface cut into layers that separate, a comment rebuilt in code,
collapse to flat) and object-3d (the studio's real screenshot on a floating device, its own cursor
and comment icons extruded, swing reveal, push with rack focus, crane, hero frame) use huashu-motion's
own studio capture and icons. depth.md: when to use which route, camera moves, what makes a space,
real material in 3D, pitfalls. The skill now defaults to depth for product films and keeps one depth
direction among the three.

om check no longer judges a parent element by its children's text through whitespace text nodes
(hidden titles were reported as cut, overlapping and low-contrast).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Real material first: om grab, placeholder and no-real-material checks, product palette over invented colour

om grab <url|folder> collects a product's logo, screenshots, colours and fonts into materials/ and
materials.md. om check --source warns on placeholder images, films with no real material, logo-only
films and a missing materials list. Palettes taken from the product skip the house-look warnings,
and the colour reference now starts from the product's own colours. The skill gathers real material
before any direction, rebuilds the interface in code traced from captures when it has to move, and
uses real or open-licensed images, never placeholders.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

One-line requests: offer real choices, default to an opening that moves, catch slides in qa

- SKILL.md step 1: for a one-line request, one message with what was understood and the few
  decisions that change the film most, each with a default and two alternatives named by
  references people recognise (answerable with "可以"). No style named -> the energetic
  default: frame 1 moving with a big move, first burst before 5 s, cuts, type a phone can read.
- SKILL.md step 5: every om qa ✗ is fixed before anyone sees the film; before the first
  showing, write and fix the notes a demanding director would give.
- director.md: a lone object glowing in on an empty dark frame is not a hook.
- om qa: "flat opening" (strongest second of the first 5 s < 1.5, or a still stretch >= 1.5 s
  there) and "the whole film barely moves" (mean < 0.6 and < 3 cuts a minute). Calibrated on
  15 films the user signed off (peaks 2-24, means 0.85-5.8) against a one-line film by a new
  user (peak 0.9, still 2.5-4.2 s, mean 0.18, no cut); none of the 15 is flagged.

Two-pair A/B with independent agents (same one-line prompt, two repos): the new skill opened
both films with full-frame type on the beat (peak 5.0 / 3.2, 6 / 3 cuts in the first 5 s)
where the old one opened on small typing in an empty frame (peak 2.4 / 1.8).
